rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for exertion or an endeavor framed as sustained hard work.

example.english: I put a lot of effort into doing the report well.
example.traditional: 我為咗做好份報告，落咗好多努力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wai6 zo2 zou6 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 nou5 lik6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the thought, time, and personal energy someone has invested in a task.

example.english: They put a lot of effort into making this gift.
example.traditional: 佢整呢份禮物花咗好多心機。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zing2 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 sam1 gei1

rows.note: Use this for a discrete attempt or trial rather than the exertion involved in doing something.

example.english: This effort failed, so we’ll think of another method.
example.traditional: 今次嘗試失敗咗，我哋再諗第二個方法。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 soeng4 si3 sat1 baai6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 nam2 dai6 ji6 go3 fong1 faat3
